conceptual_change: Transitioned from volatility-adjusted VWAP deviations to a pure relative structural ratio. This hypothesis measures the relationship between price position within the bar (close_location) and the relative liquidity intensity (volume_ratio), identifying potential mean-reversion setups where thin-volume bars exhibit excessive positional exhaustion.
rationale: This candidate is a proposed executable test derived from the selected screen survivor. It does not assert efficacy, causality, market behavior, or any performance result.
